boards.product: Wiring example: ESP32-S3 + ES8311 (speaker and mic)
boards.hardware: Any ESP32-S3 board with 16 MB flash, plus an ES8311 codec module wired as in config.h
boards.identify: Hand-wired; there is no product to match
boards.flash_port: The board's USB port. Download mode: hold BOOT while plugging in.
boards.use: Minimal voice example: hold BOOT to talk to the agent over BLE, replies play on the speaker
boards.notes: Check the user's wiring against boards/es8311-voice/config.h before flashing.

zh.product: 接线示例：ESP32-S3 + ES8311（扬声器和麦克风）
zh.hardware: 任意 16 MB Flash 的 ESP32-S3 开发板，按 config.h 接一个 ES8311 音频模块
zh.identify: 自己接线，没有对应的成品
zh.flash_port: 开发板的 USB 口。下载模式：按住 BOOT 再插 USB。
zh.use: 最小语音示例：按住 BOOT 通过 BLE 和智能体对话，回答从扬声器播放
zh.notes: 烧录前按 boards/es8311-voice/config.h 核对用户的接线。
